plugin.description: Controls the local Flathub Plex Desktop application without Plex account credentials.
plugin.requirements: Plex Desktop from Flathub (tv.plex.PlexDesktop) and an X11/XWayland desktop session.

Launch.name: Open Plex
Launch.description: Open Plex Desktop or bring its existing window to the front.

SeekBackward.name: Skip Back
SeekBackward.description: Use Plex Desktop's backward seek command.

SeekForward.name: Skip Forward
SeekForward.description: Use Plex Desktop's forward seek command.

Previous.name: Previous
Previous.description: Go to the previous playback item.

Next.name: Next
Next.description: Go to the next playback item.
